mapper.select: SELECT count(0) FROM base_rbac_user_role ur JOIN base_rbac_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id JOIN base_rbac_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.id JOIN base_rbac_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = false AND r.deleted = false AND rm.deleted = false AND m.deleted = false AND r.status = true AND m.status = true AND r.type IN (1, 2) AND (r.tenant_id IS NULL OR r.tenant_id = '') AND rm.half_checked = false AND m.scope = 1 AND m.link_url = #{linkUrl}
